main.description: One comment on a subatomic post. Flat (no nested replies) in this version. Written to the commenter's own repo; src/index.ts's /api/submit-comment reads it back off that repo to verify it before folding it into the post's shared comment thread at https://subatomic.bisks.net.

post.description: The at-uri of the net.bisks.subatomic.post this comments on.

createdAt.description: When this was posted, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
